sources.title: SA3 Variations — On-Device Sample Variations | Max Graf
sources.snippet: SA3 Variations generates Splice-style sample variations entirely on your machine. Drop in a one-shot or a loop and it produces a series of musical and timbral variations. Listen through the outputs, then drag the ones you like straight into your DAW. A batch takes around 10 seconds, runs fully on-device, and nothing is ever uploaded.

sources.title: Home | Max Graf
sources.snippet: Two new projects built on Stability AI's recent Stable Audio 3 release: Stable Audio Remix, a browser app for audio-to-audio remixing that keeps the source's tempo, key, and vocals intact; and SA3 Variations, an open-source plugin that generates Splice-style sample variations fully on-device, with a C++/MLX inference pipeline other audio developers can build their own JUCE plugins on.
